book.name: Revelesen
book.title: Revelesen Krais re Jon rene berasmenem tuma tegek wesowen peteram.

content: Rem God eterri pap yokbo wule yewotene warek letrane kelare pes kere sirem.
Sene an metem, tuma wuskiy bukre God Reri Kwoborke yan tame letrane kelare pes kere remne op wem. Kem yin God reri pap yokbo wule yewotene warek letrane kelare pes kere sen yin nowselke sirkwunte.

God reri kwomri tame wuri re temnas yin reri semenem ware re selke sirkwunem. Mowyis por reri wurya lom yokwobem tatamekene reri sig ket pemenem tatamekene rem nugwape nai tewo naibem. Remri obop sikabewai tem.
Sene God reri kwomri tame peswe reri semenem ware re kersepkap okke sirkwunem. Kersepkap ok re sam tame etemri nepkap tem. Op tem, kersepkap okke temenem kelpe wos, rem aboyei saiwokeipem.
Sene God reri kwomri tame murwe reri semenem ware re wasipeikene wamekene etek sirkwunem. Er ok re nep tem.
An metem, ok lakerebo tame, re God reri kwomri tame, re op wem.

content.text: remne pen san remri nep yerem.
ne remne nep okkap newon abo.

content: Sene an metem, God rene kwar pebo tiyke tuma wuskiy wuri etek yam. Re kirkir op wem.
Sene God reri kwomri tame eiswe re semenem pap yokbo wule warek yewomenem, re yabelke sirkwunem. God re kirkir temke, yabel re sikabewai pasen tatame remne yabel kerke eim.

Remne nugwape kerke eibem, rem God rene kenakem piswayen rene yogu townebem. Rem metem, er yaper nenbem wos rem God reri kulke temenem. Rem remri nenbem yaper wos be mesegenem. Rem God reri sig bukre be wem.

Sene God reri kwomri tame letranewe reri warek yewomenem pap yok wule re mowyis por reri wolbaye bukre tukmenem emik sirkwunem. Mowyis por eterri panen simenem kwom, nugwape neir bukre tektem. Rem mus bukrewai sekene meten rem taule kworer tabem.
Rem metbem muskene etem temenem numakene rem habon Hevenke tetane God eterne piswayen yogu townebem. Rem remri yaper nen wos be mesegenem, rem wuribai yenbo be potem.

God reri kwomri tame letrane kelare wuri kerewe reri warek yewomenem pap yok wule re Yufretis peik bukrek sirkwunem. Er peik re ok pelen aboyei gerayewom. Geb sok tem, kelow re bukre tem. Yale yokwori keryen yen rem er kelowke kebese yate.
Sene an lam, arkwu gambo mur rem atekwobukap, rem arkwu logwo, mowyis por, yikoko tuma wesowbo tame etemri elemoike wuram. Rem arkwu gambo yaperwai.

Rem kitimenakene bukre wos kebese nenbo. Rem aboyei nowselri keryen yen remne lasyin op webem. Kem kemri ei nai tame remne panen yan wuriwouke duwen kem peiktame remkene ei naite. Kitimena Sikabekene Keryen Yen God, Eterri Yabel Bukrek kem ei naite tetane.
Sene arkwu gambo rem nugwape nowselri keryen yen remne we pot a poten rem emi wurik duwem. Er emi Hibru tumak rem Armagedon webo.
Sene God reri kwomri tame letrane kelare pes kerewe reri ware re poli taukke siryewom. An metem, tuma wuskiy bukre God Reri Kwoborke tukmenem wolbayek op webem. Aboyei wos yaper tekeipye. Ab eteke.
Sene pilale nugwape abem, wakte kutebem. Agerbo agerbo kukwon an metbem. Nina bukrewai yam. Kiyi opkap nina be yabem. Yei warege mere rem opkap nina bukre be lam. Et nina burkrewai.

Er kwom sag bukre, Babilon, re kelare mur germem. Nowselri net ake kwomri kwomri aboyei tereiwem. Kiyi God re Babilon kwom sagri tatame remne lewouke labem. Sene re remri nenbem yaper wos habon pap kenakem yokem. Re remne reri warek yewomenem wain ok newon am. Er wain ok et reri pap yok wule nugwapewai. Re remne pap be metem, re remne yaperwai sein nenem.
Kersepkap okri kwowyen rem sene be tem. Kwow bukre mere rem sene be tem.
Nugwape negel met pa nel mesegenen nowselri tatame remne yeren botkuyewom. Pa wulare wulare remri lim 50 kilogram. Er pa tatame remne yaperwai nenbem, eker rem God rene piswayen wesburbem.
